name: organization_audit_events
description: Append-only attributable record of company, branch, membership and grant changes, written in the same transaction as each change.
lifecycle: Never updated or deleted by the runtime; retention follows PH-13.

columns.Meaning: Company whose change the event records.

columns.Null meaning: The actor had no membership yet, as when creating the company.

columns.Meaning: Stable dotted action identifier, such as company.created or branch.archived.
Kind of changed resource, such as company or branch.
Allowlisted non-secret change details: changed field names and, for branch events, the branch name at the time of the event. Never secrets or full payloads.

constraints.Purpose: Actions use the stable dotted identifier format.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The actor is an existing principal.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, actor_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The actor membership, when present, belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An event belongs to an existing company.
Details are always a JSON object.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX organization_audit_events_company_id_id_key ON public.organization_audit_events USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key for future references to events.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX organization_audit_events_company_time_idx ON public.organization_audit_events USING btree (company_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
